Subject: Outstanding INV-9984 — overdue, VAT & WHT clarification

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks for your patience — we want to resolve this quickly. We have an outstanding balance for INV-9984 (EUR 128,450) which was due 2026-09-30. Our accounts team paused payment because the invoice billed the UK entity and our procurement asked for a Malta-entity invoice for cross-border VAT treatment. We've attached the original invoice (INV-9984.pdf).

We also have a question on withholding tax: our local treasury needs Redwood's VAT registration certificate or EU VAT ID before we can release payment and apply the reverse-charge. If Redwood cannot provide that for the billed entity, we will need to withhold 10% until we can show evidence to auditors.

We want to avoid escalation. Proposed by our side: we can release 50% on receipt of reissued invoice to our Malta entity and the remaining 50% within 30 days after we receive the VAT registration or a formal confirmation. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:

- reissue the invoice to Heliometrics Malta Ltd (PO #HM-7219)
- provide a copy of your VAT registration certificate (EU VAT ID) or guidance on how to apply reverse-charge
- confirm whether Redwood is able to accept payment into an escrow wallet (temporary) while we clear tax admin?

Attaching: INV-9984.pdf (invoice copy).

Best,
Lucia
Billing Manager | Heliometrics

Hi Lucia — thanks for the clear proposal and the PO reference. We want to get funds cleared without delay and avoid audit friction for you.

Suggested mutual action plan (short):
1) Redwood reissues a corrected invoice to Heliometrics Malta Ltd with PO HM-7219 by EOD 2026-11-03.
2) Heliometrics releases 50% payment to Redwood operating account within 5 business days of receiving the reissued invoice.
3) Heliometrics provides WHT certificate and any local remittance docs for the withheld portion; Redwood will accept the remaining 50% within 30 days after receiving the VAT evidence or acceptable proof of reverse-charge.
4) If internal tax/admin prevents release beyond 30 days, we agree a 60-day maximum arrangement and a small one-time finance credit (0.5% of outstanding) to cover admin overhead.

On Redwood side: we can provide our EU VAT registration certificate and a signed settlement addendum via DocuSign to formalize the staged release and escrow acceptance. If you prefer escrow, we can accept funds into our payment partner escrow (we have an established workflow — I'll attach the plan).

I am including Kimberly and Marissa to expedite legal/finance approvals. If we don't have a signed plan on file by 2026-11-18, we will need to engage the collections playbook (service rate-limiting after 2026-12-01 and escalation to the credit committee). We do not want to resort to that, but we need predictable cashflow and audit traceability.

Attaching: mutual_action_plan_helio.xlsx (proposed MIP with milestone dates).

Next step: Lucia, can you confirm the internal approver and whether Heliometrics can do the 50% partial payment?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
